## Details

### elektron-firmware-tool

C, MIT licence. Unpacks Elektron .syx firmware and repacks it as a valid file. Lists Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX among supported devices - currently the only Analog Heat-relevant tool we found. Forum listing: 113 stars, repo created 2026-07-22, "last commit 1 month ago" at the time of listing.

_Sources: forum mod list (mods.php?id=7), forum thread 8_

### Overtone

Python patcher that converts the user's own OS 1.12 download. No firmware shared.

_Sources: forum thread 90_

### DigiRust

macOS patcher, "experimental Digitone II tools", use at own risk. Features include drone latch and Perform Kit restoration (see docs/FEATURES.md in the repo). Creates a verified copy locally, never talks to the instrument.

_Sources: GitHub release v1.2.0_

### SYXGRID v2

Free browser-based project editor; not a firmware mod.

_Sources: forum thread 43_

### Request: D50-type PCM / sample machine

Open request, 0 replies at time of reading.

_Sources: forum thread 84_

### Elektron Firmware Download List

Forum thread listing stock firmware. Not fetched in detail yet. Remember: this aggregator links to stock firmware sources but never hosts them.

_Sources: forum overview_

### digikit

Emulator and analysis tools. elekloader's release notes mention checking its core in 'digikit's emulator'.

_Sources: lapin-list, elekloader release v0.2.0_

### digi-roll

Browser piano roll over SysEx.

_Sources: lapin-list_

### dn2_firmware_explore

Inspect, modify and rebuild the firmware.

_Sources: lapin-list_

### dn2-cfw

Research and tools, with a flanger running on the DSP. naturarum also has an elekloader fork.

_Sources: lapin-list_

### Elektroid

Sample and SysEx manager for most Elektron devices. Which of our six devices it supports still has to be checked.

_Sources: lapin-list_
